topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: Siblings get handed a mansion, and all I got was a rain-soaked trench coat and a case colder than the fish belly skies above. Grandmother’s legacy. Sure, I get it. Family, bonds, and all that jazz, but the way these two were eyeing that place was like a couple of alley cats circling a fresh fish. I’ve seen that look before, the kind that says the past is a fine place to hide skeletons until the will is read. Not a word was wasted on niceties; it was straight to dividing the spoils. I can handle the rain, the long nights, but this—this feels like a setup. One foot in, and you’re already ankle-deep in mud.
